description: This file defines a service class 'LoginMethodService' for managing login methods, including validation, creation, updating, encryption/decryption of configs, and database interactions using TypeORM.

classes.name: LoginMethodService
classes.description: Service class for handling login method operations including validation, creation, update, encryption, and database interactions.

methods.name: validateLoginMethodId
methods.description: Validates if the provided login method ID is a valid UUID.

methods.name: readLoginMethodById
methods.description: Fetches a login method by its ID using a QueryRunner.

methods.name: validateLoginMethodName
methods.description: Validates if the login method name is valid.

methods.name: validateLoginMethodStatus
methods.description: Validates if the login method status is within allowed values.

methods.name: readLoginMethodByOrganizationId
methods.description: Retrieves login methods associated with an organization ID or null.

methods.name: encryptLoginMethodConfig
methods.description: Encrypts the login method configuration string.

methods.name: decryptLoginMethodConfig
methods.description: Decrypts the login method configuration string.

methods.name: saveLoginMethod
methods.description: Saves a login method entity to the database.

methods.name: createLoginMethod
methods.description: Creates a new login method after validation and encryption.

methods.name: createOrUpdateConfig
methods.description: Creates or updates multiple login method configurations for an organization.

methods.name: updateLoginMethod
methods.description: Updates an existing login method with new data.
